intro: Return to Quinn is a Horde quest in Silverpine Forest where an adventurer delivers a restorative draught concocted by Apothecary Renferrel to the wounded Deathstalker Quinn Yorick. Trapped and weakened at the Ivar Patch north of the Sepulcher, Quinn requires the draught before he can contemplate returning to duty.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.
Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...

clips.title: Progress
paras: My sister told me you were here to aid us. Is that true?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.
You have done me a great favor, friend.
